blurb: Ojai Angler offers guided fishing tours at Lake Casitas Recreation Area in Ojai, California. They provide expert instruction on bait selection, presentation, and structure reading to improve catch rates. The service is family-owned and operated with over 30 years of experience.

quotes.author: Adam Gallegos
quotes.text: A couple of friends and I brought our son’s fishing. The guide was super helpful and made it a lot of fun for all of us. We caught a bunch of bass and learned a lot. We are very happy with Ojai Angler!

quotes.author: Jim Gardiner
quotes.text: It was our first time fishing Casitas. Corbyn did a great job introducing my six year old to bass fishing. Couple 6 pounders and 7.5, if it was a tournament day we would have been on the podium.

quotes.author: Mike Dann
quotes.text: What a great day. The guide put us on fish and shared techniques for all three of us to catch fish especially for me as not an experienced bass fisherman. Can't wait to book the next one!

quotes.author: Chris W
quotes.text: Marc was an awesome guide. Not only does he have decades of experience fishing Lake Casitas, he is a great teacher. Even the toughest little anglers learned the ropes!

quotes.author: Christopher B
quotes.text: Amazing time fishing with Marc. Everyone in the family caught fish. Marc is a patient teacher and knows his stuff. We will certainly fish with Ojai Angler again.

quotes.author: Julia Komras
quotes.text: My family and I had the best time on our guided half day fishing tour for my husband’s birthday. Corbyn was patient and helpful the entire time.

quotes.author: Millie D
quotes.text: Awesome experience fishing with Ojai Angler! Marc was a great guide and very knowledgeable. The lake is so beautiful as well.

quotes.author: Ryan Barrett
quotes.text: Awesome experience! Marc and Amy are super easy to work with and clearly have been perfecting the experience on Lake Casitas.
